# problems

Search problems as constructables: grid worlds as path problems (`gridProblem`) with the named maps and mazes of `worlds`, constraint-satisfaction puzzles (queens, Sudoku, map colouring), classical planning domains (blocks world, towers), the sliding-tile puzzles and Towers of Hanoi with their known depths, travelling-salesman instances with optimal tours, Hamiltonian-cycle puzzles and satisfiability instances (random and planted k-SAT, pigeonhole), each a `SearchProblem`, `Csp` or `Cnf` the algorithms of `search` and `logic` run on, and a tagged registry that builds an instance of each family with the truth known about it.

- table `problemRegistry`: Tagged registry of search puzzles, tours and SAT families. `src/lib/problems/registry.ts:75` `omai-engine/problems`
